name: compact-commit-history
goal: History shows clickable commits, relative dates, source size, complexity and latency without duplicate detail panels

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Compact commit links, relative dates, metrics and no selected panel; source figures from exact revisions, latency only from actual runs.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing history cases required the old panel and duplicate actions; added assertions for compact navigation and source-only historical measures.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed standard history tests reproduce duplicate sections and absent exact-revision source metrics at 70868838.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Compact six-column history uses commit links, relative timestamps, inline long reasons and source measurements from each revision.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged standard history rendering and browser navigation tests pass at 4cf3c2c6 with the same frozen environment and test corpus.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
